test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six characters A, B, C, 1, 2 and 3 are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the character on the face opposite to C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e270ba8758901cde6814a59d1cfa060dd8992a15de87ca2c71fbdc8a643fe5e.png]
solution:
Concept: If two dice have the same face value then their clockwise/anticlockwise surfaces is known as opposite number. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06b62f9399dc2a68181459b0f918bfc53216f4946e3bf6319f7465043c5e322.png] 

Now we can see in the place of B(in dice 1) it came A(in dice 2).

In the place of 2(in dice 1) it came C(in dice 2).

So, from the given dice 2 is the opposite surface of C.

 

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2”.
